{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for commas in revenue (which would indicate thousands separators)
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print("Rows with commas in revenue:", has_commas.sum())

# Display those rows
if has_commas.sum() > 0:
    print("Sample rows with commas:", df[has_commas]['revenue'].head().tolist())"}
